1.title: EasyJet agrees to surprise takeover bid as rival US firm swoops in
1.summary: The airline says a bid from US firm Apollo has trumped a recent takeover offer from Castlelake.

2.title: Witnesses of ICE Killing in Houston Dispute the Official Account
2.summary: The agency said a Mexican resident driving a van tried to ram agents before they shot him dead. A lawyer for three passengers said that was untrue.

3.title: Trump Says He Won’t Sign Housing Bill, in Protest Over Stalled Voting Measure
3.summary: The president did not say he would veto the housing legislation, so it would still become law unless he does. But his pronouncement reflects a growing rift between him and Senate Republicans.

4.title: Mediators Trying to Pull U.S. and Iran Back From Brink, Officials Say
4.summary: Days of strikes by the two countries have given way to an uneasy pause as Qatari mediators in Iran seek to salvage the tattered truce.

5.title: East Asia braces for destructive typhoon as landslides kill 15 in Philippines
5.summary: Heading for Taiwan and south-eastern China, the 1,000 km-wide Bavi is forecast to be one of the strongest storms in decades.

6.title: At Least 12 People Die in Southern Spain Wildfire
6.summary: More than 20 people were still missing after the blaze in Andalusia, one of the deadliest on record in the country. Many of the victims were foreign tourists, the Spanish authorities said.
